question: Which mountain lies to the east of the river Kṣīrodā?
premises: The location is east of Kṣīrodā.
The site is on a mountain.
The mountain is named Amarakaṇṭaka and Śarakaṇṭaka.
inference: The mountain Amarakaṇṭaka, also called Śarakaṇṭaka, lies east of Kṣīrodā.
uncertainties: Whether Śarakaṇṭaka is a second name or a distinct place is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: To the east of Kṣīrodā, on the mountain Amarakaṇṭaka, also called Śarakaṇṭaka.
